text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in the opening paragraph","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states a direct position early and makes the argument’s main direction easy to follow."},{"evidence":"two organized body paragraphs with topic sentences","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups its reasons into distinct sections that create a more controlled argument structure."},{"evidence":"quoted article evidence followed by explanation","quality":"evidence integration","description":"The essay brings in source details and then explains how they support the claim instead of leaving the quote on its own."},{"evidence":"repeatedly explains why the quote matters","quality":"analysis","description":"The essay goes beyond summary by interpreting the article’s points and connecting them back to its position."},{"evidence":"clear links to safety and liability","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay develops its reasons in a sustained way, showing how driverless cars create problems rather than just naming them."},{"evidence":"focused conclusion restating the claim","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends by briefly reinforcing its position and main reasons in a more complete closing statement."}]}
